name: World Cup (REST API)
description: The same World Cup questions against the sample served by a local REST API ('npm run worldcup:api'). Select its REST API datasource with a saved dataset containing the api.world_cup endpoints; reference SQL runs in SQLite over the fetched endpoints.

expectedSql.champion-2022: SELECT champion.common_name AS champion FROM api.world_cup.tournaments tournament JOIN api.world_cup.teams champion ON champion.id = tournament.champion_team_id WHERE tournament.tournament_year = 2022
expectedSql.final-score-2018: SELECT home.common_name AS home_team, away.common_name AS away_team, m.home_goals, m.away_goals FROM api.world_cup.matches m JOIN api.world_cup.tournaments tournament ON tournament.id = m.tournament_id JOIN api.world_cup.teams home ON home.id = m.home_team_id JOIN api.world_cup.teams away ON away.id = m.away_team_id WHERE tournament.tournament_year = 2018 AND m.stage = 'final'
expectedSql.top-scorer-2022: SELECT player, goals FROM api.world_cup.v_player_goal_totals WHERE tournament_year = 2022 ORDER BY goals DESC, player LIMIT 1
expectedSql.shootouts: SELECT tournament_year, home_team, away_team, winner FROM api.world_cup.v_match_results WHERE home_penalties IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tournament_year, match_number
expectedSql.biggest-venue: SELECT DISTINCT venue, attendance FROM api.world_cup.v_match_results WHERE attendance = (SELECT MAX(attendance) FROM api.world_cup.v_match_results)
expectedSql.goals-by-type: SELECT goal_type, COUNT(*) AS goals FROM api.world_cup.goals GROUP BY goal_type ORDER BY goals DESC, goal_type
expectedSql.attendance-by-tournament: SELECT tr.tournament_year, SUM(m.attendance) AS total_attendance FROM api.world_cup.matches m JOIN api.world_cup.tournaments tr ON tr.id = m.tournament_id GROUP BY tr.tournament_year ORDER BY tr.tournament_year
expectedSql.pass-accuracy-by-team: SELECT t.common_name AS team FROM api.world_cup.match_team_statistics s JOIN api.world_cup.teams t ON t.id = s.team_id GROUP BY t.common_name ORDER BY CAST(SUM(s.passes_completed) AS REAL) / SUM(s.passes_attempted) DESC, t.common_name LIMIT 3
expectedSql.shot-accuracy-by-team-2022: SELECT t.common_name AS team FROM api.world_cup.match_team_statistics s JOIN api.world_cup.matches m ON m.id = s.match_id JOIN api.world_cup.tournaments tr ON tr.id = m.tournament_id JOIN api.world_cup.teams t ON t.id = s.team_id WHERE tr.tournament_year = 2022 GROUP BY t.common_name ORDER BY CAST(SUM(s.shots_on_target) AS REAL) / SUM(s.shots) DESC, t.common_name LIMIT 3
expectedSql.shot-conversion-2022: WITH team_goals AS (SELECT m.id AS match_id, m.home_team_id AS team_id, m.home_goals AS goals FROM api.world_cup.matches m JOIN api.world_cup.tournaments tr ON tr.id = m.tournament_id WHERE tr.tournament_year = 2022 UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.away_team_id, m.away_goals FROM api.world_cup.matches m JOIN api.world_cup.tournaments tr ON tr.id = m.tournament_id WHERE tr.tournament_year = 2022) SELECT t.common_name AS team FROM team_goals g JOIN api.world_cup.match_team_statistics s ON s.match_id = g.match_id AND s.team_id = g.team_id JOIN api.world_cup.teams t ON t.id = g.team_id GROUP BY t.common_name ORDER BY CAST(SUM(g.goals) AS REAL) / SUM(s.shots) DESC, t.common_name LIMIT 1
expectedSql.busiest-stadium: WITH per_venue AS (SELECT venue.name AS venue, COUNT(*) AS matches FROM api.world_cup.matches match JOIN api.world_cup.venues venue ON venue.id = match.venue_id GROUP BY venue.name) SELECT venue FROM per_venue WHERE matches = (SELECT MAX(matches) FROM per_venue)
expectedSql.highest-scoring-match: SELECT home_team, away_team FROM api.world_cup.v_match_results WHERE home_goals + away_goals = (SELECT MAX(home_goals + away_goals) FROM api.world_cup.v_match_results)
expectedSql.top-scorer-both-tournaments: WITH totals AS (SELECT player, SUM(goals) AS goals FROM api.world_cup.v_player_goal_totals GROUP BY player) SELECT player FROM totals WHERE goals = (SELECT MAX(goals) FROM totals)
expectedSql.semi-final-goals-2022: SELECT SUM(match.home_goals + match.away_goals) AS goals FROM api.world_cup.matches match JOIN api.world_cup.tournaments tournament ON tournament.id = match.tournament_id WHERE tournament.tournament_year = 2022 AND match.stage = 'semi_final'
expectedSql.goals-by-defenders: SELECT COUNT(*) AS goals FROM api.world_cup.goals goal JOIN api.world_cup.players player ON player.id = goal.scorer_player_id WHERE player.position = 'DF' AND goal.goal_type <> 'own_goal'
expectedSql.third-place-2022: SELECT winner.common_name AS team FROM api.world_cup.matches match JOIN api.world_cup.tournaments tournament ON tournament.id = match.tournament_id JOIN api.world_cup.teams winner ON winner.id = match.winner_team_id WHERE tournament.tournament_year = 2022 AND match.stage = 'third_place'
expectedSql.most-fouls-team: SELECT team.common_name AS team FROM api.world_cup.match_team_statistics stat JOIN api.world_cup.teams team ON team.id = stat.team_id GROUP BY team.common_name ORDER BY SUM(stat.fouls_committed) DESC, team.common_name LIMIT 1
expectedSql.booked-in-2022-final: SELECT player.full_name AS player FROM api.world_cup.disciplinary_events card JOIN api.world_cup.matches match ON match.id = card.match_id JOIN api.world_cup.tournaments tournament ON tournament.id = match.tournament_id JOIN api.world_cup.players player ON player.id = card.player_id WHERE tournament.tournament_year = 2022 AND match.stage = 'final'
expectedSql.quickest-goal-scorer: SELECT player.full_name AS player FROM api.world_cup.goals goal JOIN api.world_cup.players player ON player.id = goal.scorer_player_id WHERE goal.minute = (SELECT MIN(minute) FROM api.world_cup.goals)
expectedSql.goals-with-recorded-assist: SELECT COUNT(*) AS goals_with_assist FROM api.world_cup.goals WHERE assist_player_id IS NOT NULL
expectedSql.top-assist-provider: WITH assists AS (SELECT player.full_name AS player, COUNT(*) AS assists FROM api.world_cup.goals goal JOIN api.world_cup.players player ON player.id = goal.assist_player_id GROUP BY player.full_name) SELECT player FROM assists WHERE assists = (SELECT MAX(assists) FROM assists)
expectedSql.finalists-groups-2022: SELECT team.common_name AS team, entry.group_letter FROM api.world_cup.tournament_teams entry JOIN api.world_cup.tournaments tournament ON tournament.id = entry.tournament_id JOIN api.world_cup.teams team ON team.id = entry.team_id WHERE tournament.tournament_year = 2022 AND entry.team_id IN (tournament.champion_team_id, tournament.runner_up_team_id)
expectedSql.mandzukic-goals-2018: SELECT COUNT(*) AS goals FROM api.world_cup.goals goal JOIN api.world_cup.players player ON player.id = goal.scorer_player_id JOIN api.world_cup.matches match ON match.id = goal.match_id JOIN api.world_cup.tournaments tournament ON tournament.id = match.tournament_id WHERE player.full_name = 'Mario Mandzukic' AND tournament.tournament_year = 2018 AND goal.goal_type <> 'own_goal'
expectedSql.extra-time-goals: SELECT COUNT(*) AS goals FROM api.world_cup.goals WHERE minute > 90
expectedSql.argentina-draws-2022: SELECT COUNT(*) AS draws FROM api.world_cup.matches match JOIN api.world_cup.tournaments tournament ON tournament.id = match.tournament_id JOIN api.world_cup.teams team ON team.id IN (match.home_team_id, match.away_team_id) WHERE tournament.tournament_year = 2022 AND team.common_name = 'Argentina' AND match.home_goals = match.away_goals
expectedSql.south-american-goals: SELECT COUNT(*) AS goals FROM api.world_cup.goals goal JOIN api.world_cup.teams team ON team.id = goal.scoring_team_id JOIN api.world_cup.countries country ON country.code = team.country_code JOIN api.world_cup.confederations confederation ON confederation.code = country.confederation_code WHERE confederation.code = 'CONMEBOL'
expectedSql.third-placed-team-scorers-2018: SELECT DISTINCT player.full_name AS player FROM api.world_cup.tournament_teams entry JOIN api.world_cup.tournaments tournament ON tournament.id = entry.tournament_id JOIN api.world_cup.matches match ON match.tournament_id = tournament.id JOIN api.world_cup.goals goal ON goal.match_id = match.id AND goal.scoring_team_id = entry.team_id JOIN api.world_cup.players player ON player.id = goal.scorer_player_id WHERE tournament.tournament_year = 2018 AND entry.final_rank = 3 AND goal.goal_type <> 'own_goal'
